{{Top|leg}}
'''Varium''' is a type of metal used by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|First Galactic Empire]]. On a scout [[Mission to Ronyards|mission]] to [[Ronyards/Legends|Ronyards]], a group of [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] found large quantities of it, but they were [[Death/Legends|killed]] by a mysterious force before they could salvage any of it.<ref name="RNS">{{StoryCite|story=Rust Never Sleeps|book=The Empire Strikes Back Monthly 156}}</ref>
